official.deadline_note: The Master's Degree page states the window 5 October 2026 to 12 November 2026 for the 2026/2027 intake. The University's Graduate admissions page separately shows 'ADMISSION EXTENDED - Selected Graduate Programs, Fall 2026-2027, apply by July 1, 2026'. No separate RA/TA scholarship application window or deadline is published.
official.application_cycle: Fall 2026-2027 intake; master's applications open 5 October 2026 to 12 November 2026
official.status_note: The University states that applications for Master's programs will be open from 5 October 2026 to 12 November 2026; most listed master's programs show 'Applications Open'. The Graduate admissions page shows admission extended for selected graduate programs with a July 1, 2026 apply-by date.
official.tuition_coverage_note: No tuition waiver, tuition discount, stipend or expense coverage is attached to the RA/TA scholarship on either official page. The only published coverage statement is that remedial courses are not covered by the scholarship.
eligibility: Hold a Bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.20 out of 4.00 (or equivalent) for UAE national students, and 3.60 out of 4.00 (or equivalent) for non-national students.
Be committed to working 20 hours per week at the University as part of the scholarship requirements.
Not be employed outside the University during the scholarship period.
Meet any additional requirements established by the concerned academic department and the University.

Regular master's admission requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent from a university recognized by the UAE MoHESR, a minimum CGPA of 3.00 out of 4.00, and a bachelor's degree in a field relevant to the intended master's program.
requirements: Scholarship eligibility and continuation are subject to the bylaws and regulations of the University of Sharjah.
Remedial courses are not covered by the scholarship.
Meeting the minimum eligibility requirements does not guarantee the award of a scholarship; selection is subject to departmental evaluation, availability, and approval.
The concerned academic department reserves the right to select eligible candidates based on its academic and research needs and the applicable selection criteria.
Master's and Ph.D. students awarded the scholarship are required to work 20 hours per week (per the University's Graduate admissions page).
Applicants to Master's programs taught in English must obtain TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL PBT 550, or IELTS Academic 6.0; Home Edition and other online home-based English tests are not accepted.
documents: Valid Passport - copy of a valid passport.
Academic Qualifications - certified copy of the Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Bachelor's Academic Transcript.
Personal Photograph - recent passport-size color photograph.
Emirates ID - copy of a valid UAE national identity card.
UAE National Family Book - copy, where applicable.
English Language Proficiency - valid IELTS Academic, TOEFL iBT, or PTE Academic certificate, or official proof the bachelor's degree was taught in English.
Academic Recommendation Letters - two letters from professors who taught or supervised the applicant during the bachelor's degree.
UoS Alumni Card - for University of Sharjah graduates, where applicable.
MoHESR certificate recognition/equivalency for qualifications obtained outside the UAE.
Kuwait Embassy Cultural Office approval letter - for Kuwaiti applicants.
Employment Letter - from the employer confirming current employment, for employed applicants.
selection_criteria: The concerned academic department reserves the right to select eligible candidates based on its academic and research needs and the applicable selection criteria.
Selection is subject to departmental evaluation, availability, and approval.
Undergraduate CGPA thresholds: 3.20 out of 4.00 for UAE national students and 3.60 out of 4.00 for non-national students.
coverage: No coverage list is published on the official pages. The University states only that it offers Research Assistant (RA) and Teaching Assistant (TA) scholarships to eligible Master's students, subject to the University's applicable bylaws, regulations, and available opportunities, and that remedial courses are not covered.
application_method: Discover your program by selecting a college to view the master's programs and specializations offered.
Check your eligibility against the regular and conditional master's admission requirements.
Complete the required English language test, or provide official proof the bachelor's degree was taught in English.
Get your documents ready (passport, certified bachelor's certificate and transcript, photograph, Emirates ID, two recommendation letters, MoHESR equivalence where applicable).
Explore scholarships and benefits, including RA/TA scholarship eligibility and the programme exclusion list.
Submit the online application through the University of Sharjah Online Admission Portal (admservices.sharjah.ac.ae), upload all required documents, and pay the AED 500 non-refundable application fee.
If nominated for admission, reserve the seat by paying AED 10,000 within the specified deadline; AED 5,000 is non-refundable on withdrawal or non-enrollment.
official.application_route: Apply for master's admission through the University of Sharjah Online Admission Portal; RA/TA selection is then made by the concerned academic department, with no separate scholarship application published.
official.study_mode: Full Time (master's programs are offered full-time or part-time depending on the program; most listed master's programs offer Full Time / Part Time)
official.citizenship_residency: No citizenship or residency restriction for the RA/TA scholarship itself; different CGPA thresholds apply to UAE nationals (3.20/4.00) and non-nationals (3.60/4.00).
official.international_eligibility: Yes - non-national students are explicitly eligible under a higher CGPA threshold (3.60 out of 4.00).
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Enrollment in a master's program not on the published exclusion list. Excluded: all five Master of Dental Surgery programs (Orthodontics, Oral Surgery, Endodontics, Periodontology, Prosthodontics), Master of Science in Leadership in Health Professions Education, Master of Leadership in Higher Education, Executive Master in Business Administration, and Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD). Master of Science in Molecular Medicine and Translational Research students may apply for a Research Assistant scholarship only and are not eligible for the Teaching Assistant scholarship.
official.research_requirement: Research Assistant scholarship holders work 20 hours per week at the University in line with the department's academic and research needs; no separate research proposal is published as an application requirement.
official.duration: Tied to enrolment in the master's program; continuation is subject to the bylaws and regulations of the University of Sharjah. No fixed scholarship duration is published.
official.description: The University of Sharjah offers Research Assistant (RA) and Teaching Assistant (TA) scholarships to eligible Master's students, subject to the University's applicable bylaws, regulations, and available opportunities. Recipients commit to working 20 hours per week at the University and may not be employed outside it, with selection made by the concerned academic department based on its academic and research needs.
official.english_requirement: Applicants to Master's programs taught in English must obtain TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL PBT 550, or IELTS Academic 6.0. Applicants to the Master of Applied Sociology, Master in Private Law, Master in Public Law, Master in Conservation Management of Cultural Heritage, and Master of Arts in Applied Criminology and Criminal Justice must either obtain a minimum TOEFL ITP score of 450 or its equivalent, a minimum IELTS Academic score of 4.5, or successfully complete the prescribed English language course (ESL - 0 credit hours) during the first semester. Native English speakers and graduates of universities where English was the language of instruction may be exempt. Test results are valid for two years, and Home Edition or other online home-based English tests are not accepted.

verification.notes: Checked the University of Sharjah Master's Degree admissions page (RA/TA section, exclusions, deadlines, fees, English and document rules) and the Graduate admissions page (RA/TA scholarship terms and deadline notice). Neither official page publishes a monetary benefit, tuition waiver, or coverage list, so all amount and coverage fields are left null. Tuition figures appear only in the University's separate published fee structure, not as scholarship benefits.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a work-based assistantship rather than a cash award: the University of Sharjah funds eligible master's students who commit 20 hours per week to Research or Teaching Assistant duties and give up any outside employment. No stipend amount, tuition waiver, or expense coverage is published anywhere on the official pages, so treat the financial value as unknown until the department confirms it in writing. Apply through the regular master's admission route inside the 5 October to 12 November 2026 window and check your programme against the exclusion list before building any plans around the award.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-CGPA master's applicants (3.60/4.00 if non-national, 3.20/4.00 if Emirati) who want to study at Sharjah, can give 20 hours a week to university work, and have no outside job.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target programme is not on the published exclusion list (all five Master of Dental Surgery programs, MSc Leadership in Health Professions Education, Master of Leadership in Higher Education, Executive MBA, PharmD) - and note MSc Molecular Medicine and Translational Research is RA-only, not TA.
Verify your bachelor's CGPA clears the higher bar for your nationality track: 3.60/4.00 for non-nationals, 3.20/4.00 for UAE nationals.
Book TOEFL iBT (79), IELTS Academic (6.0), or PTE Academic early - Home Edition and online home-based tests are rejected, and results are only valid for two years.
Line up certified coloured copies of your bachelor's degree and transcript, plus two recommendation letters from professors who taught or supervised you.
Budget the AED 500 non-refundable application fee and, if admitted, the AED 10,000 seat reservation (AED 5,000 lost if you withdraw or do not enrol).
If your degree is from outside the UAE, start the MoHESR equivalency process before you apply, since it is required documentation.
common_rejection_risks: Applying to a programme on the exclusion list, or assuming TA is available in Molecular Medicine and Translational Research when only RA is.
CGPA below the nationality-specific scholarship threshold even though general master's admission only needs 3.00/4.00.
Submitting a Home Edition TOEFL/IELTS or a test older than two years, which the University states it will not accept.
Missing the 12 November 2026 application window - the University publishes no separate RA/TA application round.
Being currently employed elsewhere: holders may not work outside the University, and an employer letter is required if you are employed at application time.
Assuming the scholarship is guaranteed on meeting minimums - the department awards it only where it has academic/research need and budget.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The official pages attach no payment to the scholarship, so applicants should expect to fund the AED 500 application fee, the AED 10,000 seat reservation, tuition, and living costs themselves. The University's published fee structure for master's students admitted from 2022/2023 lists fees per credit hour (AED 3,200 for most master's programmes, AED 4,200 for the MBA and Executive MBA-related business programmes, AED 3,500 for Biomedical Engineering) plus programme-specific annual fees such as AED 68,250 for the PharmD. Housing, meals, insurance and travel are not addressed by the scholarship at all, and remediation classes are explicitly not covered.
document_audit: Certificates and transcripts must be certified copies and colour copies are requested on the Graduate admissions page - plain black-and-white scans are a routine rejection reason.
Recommendation letters must come from professors who taught or supervised you at bachelor's level, not employers or referees from later roles.
An Emirates ID and/or Family Book copy is requested; non-Emirati applicants typically hold a residence visa instead, and the document list explicitly allows Family Book or Residence Visa.

Employed applicants must attach a letter from their employer confirming current employment - this clashes with the 'no outside work' rule only after award, so read it as a disclosure requirement, not a bar.
Kuwaiti applicants need a Kuwait Embassy Cultural Office approval letter, and male Emirati applicants aged 18-30 need the National and Reserve Service No Objection Certificate.
alerts: The two official pages disagree on timing: the Master's Degree page sets 5 October - 12 November 2026, while the Graduate admissions page shows an extended deadline of 1 July 2026 for selected graduate programs. Verify the current MASTER's intake deadline with the admissions office before relying on either date.
The scholarship is awarded by the concerned academic department based on its own needs and available positions - numbers are limited and not published, so a strong CGPA does not secure it.
The award locks you into university-only employment for the whole period; turning down or leaving outside work is a real career cost.
Remedial or prerequisite courses (up to 24 credit hours for applicants from a different field) are not covered by the scholarship.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Create an account on the University of Sharjah Online Admission Portal, complete the master's application, upload documents and pay the AED 500 fee within the published window, then wait for the admission decision (the University states an email on admission status within 7 working days) - RA/TA nomination and any benefit terms then come from the concerned department.
